# Please do not edit this file manually

provider = "postgresql"

// Kwetu Zambia — Prisma schema
// NOTE: SQLite for zero-config local dev. Written to be Postgres-compatible —
// see BUILD_GUIDE.md "Swapping SQLite -> Postgres" for the one-line datasource change.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// ---------- Identity ----------

// Role values (SQLite has no enum support): CONSUMER, SUPPLIER, ADMIN

model User {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  name         String
  email        String   @unique
  passwordHash String
  role         String   @default("CONSUMER")
  phone        String?
  verified     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  wallet            Wallet?
  bookingsBus       BusBooking[]
  stayBookings      StayBooking[]
  eventTickets      EventTicket[]
  serviceBookings   ServiceBooking[]
  insurancePolicies InsurancePolicy[]
  operators         Operator[]        @relation("OperatorOwner")
  properties        Property[]        @relation("PropertyOwner")
  events            Event[]           @relation("EventOwner")
  serviceListings   ServiceListing[]  @relation("ServiceOwner")
  rentalListings    PropertyListing[] @relation("RentalOwner")
  landListings      LandListing[]     @relation("LandOwner")
  referralClicks    ReferralClick[]
  ledgerAccount     LedgerAccount?
}

// ---------- Wallet / Loyalty ----------

model Wallet {
  id                     String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId                 String   @unique
  user                   User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  balanceMinor           Int      @default(0) // ZMW cents
  loyaltyPoints          Int      @default(0)
  completedBookingsCount Int      @default(0) // used for every-5th-booking fee waiver
  updatedAt              DateTime @updatedAt
}

// ---------- Double-entry ledger ----------

// LedgerAccountType values (SQLite has no enum support): USER_WALLET, SUPPLIER_PAYABLE, KWETU_REVENUE, KWETU_VAT_PAYABLE, INSURER_PAYABLE, REFERRAL_PAYABLE, CASH_CLEARING // represents inbound customer payment rail (mobile money/card)

model LedgerAccount {
  id        String        @id @default(cuid())
  type      String
  name      String
  userId    String?       @unique
  user      User?         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  entries   LedgerEntry[]
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
}

model LedgerTransaction {
  id             String        @id @default(cuid())
  idempotencyKey String        @unique
  description    String
  entries        LedgerEntry[]
  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now())
}

model LedgerEntry {
  id             String            @id @default(cuid())
  transactionId  String
  transaction    LedgerTransaction @relation(fields: [transactionId], references: [id])
  accountId      String
  account        LedgerAccount     @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id])
  direction      String // "DEBIT" | "CREDIT"
  amountMinor    Int // always positive, ZMW cents
  runningBalance Int // account balance after this entry, in cents
  createdAt      DateTime          @default(now())

  @@index([accountId])
}

// ---------- Payments / Commission ----------

// PaymentStatus values (SQLite has no enum support): PENDING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED

model Payment {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  idempotencyKey String   @unique
  provider       String // "MockMoneyProvider"
  method         String // AIRTEL_MONEY | MTN_MONEY | ZAMTEL_KWACHA | CARD
  status         String   @default("PENDING")
  amountMinor    Int
  reference      String
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  commission Commission?
}

model Commission {
  id                    String   @id @default(cuid())
  paymentId             String   @unique
  payment               Payment  @relation(fields: [paymentId], references: [id])
  vertical              String
  baseAmountMinor       Int // supplier's price
  commissionAmountMinor Int // Kwetu fee added on top (pre-VAT)
  vatAmountMinor        Int // 16% VAT on the commission
  totalAmountMinor      Int // base + commission + VAT = what customer pays
  ratePct               Float
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
}

// ---------- Vertical 1: Intercity bus travel ----------

model Operator {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  ownerId   String
  owner     User     @relation("OperatorOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  verified  Boolean  @default(false)
  routes    Route[]
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model Route {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  operatorId  String
  operator    Operator @relation(fields: [operatorId], references: [id])
  origin      String
  destination String
  trips       Trip[]
}

model Trip {
  id             String       @id @default(cuid())
  routeId        String
  route          Route        @relation(fields: [routeId], references: [id])
  departAt       DateTime
  arriveAt       DateTime
  basePriceMinor Int
  busPlate       String
  totalSeats     Int          @default(44)
  seats          Seat[]
  bookings       BusBooking[]
}

// SeatStatus values (SQLite has no enum support): AVAILABLE, HELD, BOOKED

model Seat {
  id        String      @id @default(cuid())
  tripId    String
  trip      Trip        @relation(fields: [tripId], references: [id])
  seatNo    String
  status    String      @default("AVAILABLE")
  heldUntil DateTime?
  bookingId String?
  booking   BusBooking? @relation(fields: [bookingId], references: [id])

  @@unique([tripId, seatNo])
}

// BookingStatus values (SQLite has no enum support): PENDING_PAYMENT, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED

model BusBooking {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  tripId        String
  trip          Trip     @relation(fields: [tripId], references: [id])
  seats         Seat[]
  status        String   @default("PENDING_PAYMENT")
  passengerName String
  totalMinor    Int
  paymentId     String?
  feeWaived     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
}

// ---------- Vertical 2: Accommodation ----------

model Property {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  ownerId     String
  owner       User     @relation("PropertyOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  name        String
  city        String
  description String
  verified    Boolean  @default(false)
  rooms       Room[]
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

model Room {
  id                String        @id @default(cuid())
  propertyId        String
  property          Property      @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id])
  type              String
  ratePerNightMinor Int
  quantity          Int           @default(1)
  bookings          StayBooking[]
}

model StayBooking {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  roomId     String
  room       Room     @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id])
  checkIn    DateTime
  checkOut   DateTime
  status     String   @default("PENDING_PAYMENT")
  totalMinor Int
  paymentId  String?
  feeWaived  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
}

// ---------- Vertical 3: Event ticketing ----------

model Event {
  id          String       @id @default(cuid())
  ownerId     String
  owner       User         @relation("EventOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  name        String
  venue       String
  startsAt    DateTime
  verified    Boolean      @default(false)
  ticketTiers TicketTier[]
  createdAt   DateTime     @default(now())
}

model TicketTier {
  id         String        @id @default(cuid())
  eventId    String
  event      Event         @relation(fields: [eventId], references: [id])
  name       String
  priceMinor Int
  quantity   Int
  sold       Int           @default(0)
  tickets    EventTicket[]
}

model EventTicket {
  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  user         User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  ticketTierId String
  ticketTier   TicketTier @relation(fields: [ticketTierId], references: [id])
  qrCode       String     @unique
  status       String     @default("PENDING_PAYMENT")
  totalMinor   Int
  paymentId    String?
  feeWaived    Boolean    @default(false)
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())
}

// ---------- Vertical 4: Local services marketplace ----------

model ServiceListing {
  id          String           @id @default(cuid())
  ownerId     String
  owner       User             @relation("ServiceOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  title       String
  category    String
  description String
  priceMinor  Int
  verified    Boolean          @default(false)
  bookings    ServiceBooking[]
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())
}

// ServiceJobStatus values (SQLite has no enum support): REQUESTED, ACCEPTED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED

model ServiceBooking {
  id         String         @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  user       User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  listingId  String
  listing    ServiceListing @relation(fields: [listingId], references: [id])
  status     String         @default("REQUESTED")
  totalMinor Int
  paymentId  String?
  feeWaived  Boolean        @default(false)
  createdAt  DateTime       @default(now())
}

// ---------- Vertical 5: Property rental placement ----------

// ListingPeriod values (SQLite has no enum support): DAYS_7, DAYS_14, DAYS_30

model PropertyListing {
  id                String    @id @default(cuid())
  ownerId           String
  owner             User      @relation("RentalOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  title             String
  city              String
  monthlyRentMinor  Int
  description       String
  contactPhone      String
  period            String    @default("DAYS_14")
  placementFeeMinor Int
  paidUntil         DateTime?
  verified          Boolean   @default(false)
  createdAt         DateTime  @default(now())
}

// ---------- Vertical 6: Land sales listings ----------

model LandListing {
  id                String    @id @default(cuid())
  ownerId           String
  owner             User      @relation("LandOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  title             String
  location          String
  sizeAcres         Float
  priceMinor        Int
  description       String
  contactPhone      String
  placementFeeMinor Int
  paidUntil         DateTime?
  verified          Boolean   @default(false)
  createdAt         DateTime  @default(now())
}

// ---------- Vertical 7: Travel & micro-insurance ----------

model InsuranceQuote {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  productType     String // "TRAVEL" | "ACCOMMODATION_ADDON"
  premiumMinor    Int
  coverageSummary String
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now())
  policy          InsurancePolicy?
}

model InsurancePolicy {
  id        String         @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  quoteId   String         @unique
  quote     InsuranceQuote @relation(fields: [quoteId], references: [id])
  status    String         @default("BOUND") // BOUND | CLAIMED | EXPIRED
  paymentId String?
  createdAt DateTime       @default(now())
}

// ---------- Vertical 8: Partner referrals ----------

model ReferralPartner {
  id          String          @id @default(cuid())
  name        String // e.g. "Yango"
  category    String // RIDES | FOOD | PARCEL
  outboundUrl String
  ratePct     Float           @default(4.0)
  clicks      ReferralClick[]
}

model ReferralClick {
  id        String          @id @default(cuid())
  partnerId String
  partner   ReferralPartner @relation(fields: [partnerId], references: [id])
  userId    String?
  user      User?           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime        @default(now())
}
